id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

toolName.description: Semantic name for the tool. Used for agent prompts.

toolDescription.description: Natural language description for the tool. Used for agent prompts.

formattingMessage.description:
Natural language message appended prior to llm generation. Helps prompt the agent to correctly format to tool input.
Ignored if not provided.

e.g. "\n[SYSTEM MESSAGE: {toolName} requires inputing a start date and end date.]"

examples.description: Array of {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Example}s for this tool.

uiOptions.description:
Configuration for how this will be shown as a UI drop-down option if {@link Genai.Agent.Config}
uiToolOptions includes this tool.

overrideRuntimeKwargs.description:
Runtime keywords arguments passed into the tool. Enables overriding of default behavior such
 as default prompts for specific sub tools.

 Format of configs for the {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.UnstructuredDataQuery}:
```json
 {
    "find_time_information_kwargs": {
        "default_span": dict,
        "default_interval": str,
        "default_interval_thresholds": dict,
        "default_timezone": dict,
        "default_timezone_offset": dict,
        "find_start_time_information_prompt": str,
        "find_end_time_information_prompt": str,
    }
 }
```

generateArgsPrompt.description:
The prompt used to generate the arguments for {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.C3Method#methodType} given a user's query.
The prompt will contain:
    1. General boilerplate and llm instructions
    2. Documentation of the method and its parameters (derived from the type documentation by default)
    3. (optional) Some few-shot examples
    4. One remaining parameter (`query`) for the user's query

generateArgsLlmConfigName.description: The {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig} to be used for generating the arguments for the method call

fillPromptOverrideLambda.description: Optional override of {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.C3Method#fillPrompt} to customize the prompt generation.

generateArgsOverrideLambda.description: Optional override of {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.C3Method#generateArgs} to customize how the args are generated

invokeMethodOverrideLambda.description:
Optional override of {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.C3Method#invokeMethod} to customize how the method is invoked
given the arguments from {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.C3Method}.
